ui.settings.brightness_veil: This monitor will not take brightness commands, so the prayer screen is darkened instead. That looks dimmer but uses the same power — the monitor's own buttons do more.
ui.settings.buttons_hint: Pair the ring once in the Pi's Bluetooth settings. The circle is green when it is connected.
ui.settings.cursor_hint: Show the pointer if you are using a mouse, or if the touchscreen isn't working.
ui.settings.downloads_off: Language downloads aren't set up yet.
ui.settings.font_hint: All three show the vowel marks in full. Pick whichever is easiest to read on the screen.
ui.settings.inset_hint: If the monitor cuts off an edge, this keeps that much clear all the way round.
ui.settings.mat_sim_hint: Shows exactly what the two mat panels would display, including the time it takes to send pages over Bluetooth.
ui.settings.mat_speed_hint: Turn off to send pages instantly while testing.
ui.settings.no_player: No audio player found. Install one with: sudo apt install mpg123
ui.settings.place_hint: Times are worked out on the device using the Muslim World League method, from your location and the school above. Set your location in ~/.config/salaah/settings.json (latitude, longitude, place).
ui.settings.recitation_hint: Plays a recording of the verses on screen and turns each word red as it is recited. Meant for learning and practice. The bar in the top row sets how loud it is.
ui.settings.swap_panels_hint: Normally the posture is on the left panel and the words on the right.
ui.settings.theme_auto: Automatic: dark from Maghrib to sunrise
ui.settings.timings_estimated: The word timings are worked out from the length of the text, not taken by ear, so the red will drift. Fix them with tools/tap_timings.py.

ui.timing.saved: Saved. Watch it back.  Press for the next one, back to tap this one again.
ui.timing.saved_missed: Saved, but {n} word(s) had no tap and were guessed. Back to tap it again.
ui.timing.tapping: Press as each red word begins.  Back starts this one again.

ayat_kursi: God: there is no god but Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of all.
Neither drowsiness nor sleep overtakes Him.
To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth.
Who could intercede with Him except by His leave?
He knows what is before them and what is behind them,
and they grasp nothing of His knowledge except what He wills.
His Seat extends over the heavens and the earth,
and guarding them does not tire Him.
He is the Most High, the Tremendous.
dhikr_salam: O God, You are Peace and from You comes peace.
Blessed are You, Owner of majesty and honour.
dhikr_tahlil: There is no god but God alone, with no partner.
His is the dominion and His is the praise,
and He has power over all things.
falaq: In the name of God, the Most Merciful, the Most Compassionate.
Say: I seek refuge with the Lord of the daybreak
from the harm of what He created,
from the harm of darkness as it settles,
from the harm of those who blow on knots,
and from the harm of an envier when he envies.
fatiha: In the name of God, the Most Merciful, the Most Compassionate.
All praise belongs to God, Lord of all the worlds,
the Most Merciful, the Most Compassionate,
Master of the Day of Judgement.
You alone we worship, and You alone we ask for help.
Guide us along the straight path,
the path of those You have blessed, not of those who earned anger, nor of those who went astray.
ikhlas: In the name of God, the Most Merciful, the Most Compassionate.
Say: He is God, the One.
God, the Eternal, on whom all depend.
He does not give birth, nor was He born,
and there is none comparable to Him.
istiftah: Glory be to You, O God, and all praise is Yours.
Blessed is Your name and exalted is Your majesty.
There is no god but You.
kawthar: In the name of God, the Most Merciful, the Most Compassionate.
We have surely given you abundance.
So pray to your Lord and sacrifice.
It is the one who hates you who is cut off.
nas: In the name of God, the Most Merciful, the Most Compassionate.
Say: I seek refuge with the Lord of people,
from the harm of the whisperer who withdraws,
who whispers into the hearts of people,
qunut_1: O God, we ask You for help, we ask Your forgiveness, we believe in You and we rely on You.
We praise You for all good, we thank You and we are not ungrateful to You.
We cast off and leave whoever disobeys You.
qunut_2: O God, You alone we worship; for You we pray and prostrate.
To You we strive and hasten. We hope for Your mercy and fear Your punishment.
Your punishment surely reaches those who reject faith.
rabbana_atina: Our Lord, give us good in this world
and good in the hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.
ruku_tasbih: Glory to my Lord, the Most Great.
salam: Peace be upon you, and the mercy of God.
salawat: O God, send Your grace upon Muhammad and upon the family of Muhammad,
as You sent grace upon Abraham and upon the family of Abraham. You are worthy of praise, full of glory.
O God, send Your blessings upon Muhammad and upon the family of Muhammad,
as You blessed Abraham and the family of Abraham. You are worthy of praise, full of glory.
sujood_tasbih: Glory to my Lord, the Most High.
taawwudh_basmala: I seek refuge with God from Satan, the rejected.
tashahhud: All greetings, prayers and good things belong to God.
Peace be upon you, O Prophet, and the mercy of God and His blessings.
Peace be upon us and upon the righteous servants of God.
I bear witness that there is no god but God, and that Muhammad is His servant and messenger.
tasmi_tahmid: God hears the one who praises Him.
Our Lord, to You belongs all praise.
